NSRegulatoryPrivacyDisclosureSummary.target: To support fetching icons in a way that preserves your privacy, Passwords will securely access sensors and data such as your browser history.

UNINSTALL_ICON_BODY_DELETE_DATA.target:
Deleting this app will turn off password and passkey suggestions from Passwords when you’re signing in to accounts. Your saved passwords and passkeys, including your shared items, will not be deleted.

You can reinstall the Passwords app from the App Store to restore access to this information and turn on AutoFill.

NSRegulatoryPrivacyDisclosureContacts.target: Contacts access allows you to create shared password groups with trusted contacts. The app will ask permission before accessing your contacts.

NSRegulatoryPrivacyDisclosureBrowsingHis.target: Browser History access allows fetching icons in a way that preserves your privacy. The Passwords app only makes icon requests to websites you have visited on your device in the past 30 days.
